acxii-acne-brightening-soap.heading: Why it is on the shelf
acxii-acne-brightening-soap.lead: Half the people who ask us about breakouts have a drawer of half-used serums and no cleanser worth the name. A bar with an active in it is the cheapest change to make, and the easiest one to keep up.
acxii-acne-brightening-soap.wear: Once a day to start, in the evening, not twice. A cleansing bar with an active in it is easy to overdo and dry, tight skin an hour later is the usual sign that you have. Build up to twice daily only if your skin is comfortable. Follow it with a moisturiser every time, and wear sunscreen the next morning — exfoliating acids make skin more sensitive to UV, which undoes the tone work faster than the bar can do it.

ahc-premier-ampoule-in-eye-cream-40ml-1-.heading: Why it is on the shelf
ahc-premier-ampoule-in-eye-cream-40ml-1-.lead: Most eye creams come in a pot the size of a thimble and run out before you know whether they work. This one is large enough to use twice a day for months, which is the only way to find out.
ahc-premier-ampoule-in-eye-cream-40ml-1-.wear: A grain of rice per eye, patted with the ring finger from the outer corner inwards. Morning and night. Do not drag, and do not go closer than the orbital bone — product migrates towards the eye on its own overnight, and starting too close is how people wake up puffy.

ampoule-sheet-mask.heading: Why it is on the shelf
ampoule-sheet-mask.lead: Sold one at a time, so you can work through the range and find the one that suits you rather than committing to a box of ten. Twenty minutes is the whole commitment.
ampoule-sheet-mask.wear: Over a cleansed, toned face for fifteen to twenty minutes. Press in what is left rather than rinsing, and follow with a moisturiser. Twice a week is plenty.

anjo-professional-365-70g.heading: Why it is on the shelf
anjo-professional-365-70g.lead: The best sunscreen is the one you will put on tomorrow as well. This is the plain, untinted, no-argument version for anyone who has given up on the ones that sit grey on the skin.
anjo-professional-365-70g.wear: The last step of a morning routine, after moisturiser and before makeup. Two fingers' worth for the face and neck, and reapply through the day if you are outside for any length of time. It sits under a base without pilling, which is more than most high-SPF creams manage.

anjo-professional-365-sun-bb-cream-spf50.heading: Why it is on the shelf
anjo-professional-365-sun-bb-cream-spf50.lead: Two steps collapse into one, which is the difference between wearing sunscreen every day and wearing it when you remember. The tint is light enough that it is a base rather than a decision.
anjo-professional-365-sun-bb-cream-spf50.wear: The last step of a morning routine. On its own for a day with nothing on, or under a foundation when there is. Reapply through the day if you are outside — a sun bb cream is still a sunscreen, and nothing survives six hours of daylight without a second coat.

artisan-ribbed-knit-midi-dress.heading: Why we took this one
artisan-ribbed-knit-midi-dress.lead: We buy very few dresses that come with a second piece, because most detachable things look detachable. This vest does not — and taken off, it is a good vest in its own right, which is really two purchases for one.
artisan-ribbed-knit-midi-dress.wear: With ankle boots and bare legs in September, with tall boots and opaque tights from November. The vest on and a long coat over the top is the version that goes out in January. Take the vest off and the dress will carry a blazer. In black it is the most formal of the three; the beige is the one that photographs best and the brown is the one we reorder most.

asymmetrical-tartan-pleated-midi-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
asymmetrical-tartan-pleated-midi-skirt.lead: A plain tartan skirt is a plain tartan skirt. The pleated panel down one side is the whole reason this one came back with us: standing still it is heritage, walking it is something else entirely.
asymmetrical-tartan-pleated-midi-skirt.wear: A plain cream knit and ankle boots is the obvious way to wear it and still the best one — the skirt is doing enough and anything else patterned will fight it. For work, a fine black polo neck tucked in and flat loafers. The violet in the plaid is the colour to pick up if you want to make more of it: a violet scarf or a bag, nothing larger.

autumn-explorer.heading: Why we took this one
autumn-explorer.lead: A jacket that fits nobody in particular fits almost everybody, which is the quiet trick of a boxy cut. The tie cuffs mean you can make it sharper on a day when you want it sharper.
autumn-explorer.wear: Dark denim and a seasonal knit is the straightforward version. Over a midi skirt and boots it reads as deliberate rather than practical, which is the better outfit. Tie the cuffs tight and push the sleeves to the elbow when it warms up; leave them loose over a jumper when it does not.

bear-motif-knit-vest.heading: Why we took this one
bear-motif-knit-vest.lead: The single most asked-about thing in the shop. He is knitted in rather than printed on, so he will not crack or peel, and he is wearing a tiny hoodie of his own.
bear-motif-knit-vest.wear: Over a crisp white tee, a long-sleeved top, or a collared shirt if you want the preppy version. Jeans or a cord skirt below. Nothing else with a motif on it.

beaute-angel-queens-cushion-15g-long-las.heading: Why it is on the shelf
beaute-angel-queens-cushion-15g-long-las.lead: A cushion is the one piece of makeup worth carrying: ten seconds, no mirror ritual, no brush to clean. We stock the shade most people here actually wear rather than a wall of them.
beaute-angel-queens-cushion-15g-long-las.wear: Press, do not sweep — a cushion applied with a dragging motion goes patchy. Two or three passes over the centre of the face and blend outwards. Build a second layer only where you want it. Over sunscreen in the morning, and again at four o'clock if the day has gone on.

beaute-glutathione-vitamin-ampoule-balm.heading: Why it is on the shelf
beaute-glutathione-vitamin-ampoule-balm.lead: An ampoule in a bottle stays on the bathroom shelf. In a twist-up compact it goes in a bag and gets used on the patch that needs it, which is the point of a brightening product in the first place.
beaute-glutathione-vitamin-ampoule-balm.wear: Press it onto the areas that want it — around the mouth, the sides of the nose, anywhere a mark is fading — over or under makeup. It will sit under a cushion compact without moving it. Morning or evening, or both, as a targeted step rather than a routine one.

beaute-vita-collagen-tone-up-cream-45ml-.heading: Why it is on the shelf
beaute-vita-collagen-tone-up-cream-45ml-.lead: Most tone-up creams are tacky enough that you only wear them once. This one finishes dewy and sits under everything else, so it reads as skin rather than as a product you put on.
beaute-vita-collagen-tone-up-cream-45ml-.wear: The last step of a morning routine, two fingers' worth for face and neck. On its own for a day with no makeup planned, or as the base under a cushion compact. Reapply through the day if you are outside — the brightening effect fades before the protection does, so trust the clock rather than your reflection.

belted-shirt-dress.heading: Why we took this one
belted-shirt-dress.lead: A self-tie belt means the waist sits where yours is rather than where a pattern cutter guessed. The skirt is full enough to move and plain enough to wear to work.
belted-shirt-dress.wear: Belted with boots for the weekday version; open over wide trousers as a layer. Flat sandals in summer, tights and a boot in winter.

bonny-hill-straw-berry-collagen-heartlea.heading: Why it is on the shelf
bonny-hill-straw-berry-collagen-heartlea.lead: Toner pads replaced bottled toner here almost overnight, because you use the right amount without thinking about it. This is the one for brightness, with enough heartleaf in it not to sting.
bonny-hill-straw-berry-collagen-heartlea.wear: Sweep one over a cleansed face, following the lines of the face outwards, morning or night. Or lay a pad flat on a patch that needs it — a red cheek, a dull forehead — for three or four minutes and then press in what is left. Follow with a serum and a cream as usual.

bonnyhill-ampoule-mask-sheet.heading: Why it is on the shelf
bonnyhill-ampoule-mask-sheet.lead: The quickest way to find out whether an ingredient suits you is twenty minutes with it on your face, not six weeks and a full-size bottle. Three versions, so you can test three answers.
bonnyhill-ampoule-mask-sheet.wear: Over a cleansed, toned face. Fifteen to twenty minutes is enough. Peel it off, press in what is left rather than rinsing, and follow with a moisturiser to seal it. Twice a week is plenty; a sheet mask is a treatment rather than a step.

bonnyhill-honeybee-propolis-cream.heading: Why it is on the shelf
bonnyhill-honeybee-propolis-cream.lead: Every winter somebody comes in with skin that has stopped behaving and a routine of nine products. This is the one we hand them: thick, uncomplicated, and nothing in it trying to be clever.
bonnyhill-honeybee-propolis-cream.wear: The last step at night, over a serum, or the only step on a day when nothing else is happening. Warm a little between the fingers first; a cream this thick drags if you apply it cold. In high summer, keep it for the patches that need it rather than the whole face.

bonnyhill-ultra-moisturizing-heartleaf-t.heading: Why it is on the shelf
bonnyhill-ultra-moisturizing-heartleaf-t.lead: The plainest thing on the skincare shelf and the one we restock most. No acid, no fruit, nothing to react to — which is exactly what reactive skin is looking for.
bonnyhill-ultra-moisturizing-heartleaf-t.wear: Sweep one over clean skin morning and night, working outwards. For a red patch, lay two flat over it for five minutes and press in what is left. They hydrate enough that a serum afterwards is optional, which is useful on a day when your skin wants less rather than more.

bonnyhill-ultra-moisturizing-rice-niacin.heading: Why it is on the shelf
bonnyhill-ultra-moisturizing-rice-niacin.lead: Two actives most people were buying separately, in one pot, at the price of one of them. If your routine has grown to six steps, this is where to start cutting.
bonnyhill-ultra-moisturizing-rice-niacin.wear: Morning or night, after whatever serum you use and before sunscreen. It layers under makeup without pilling. If your routine has grown to six steps and you are wondering which to cut, this is the one that replaces two of them.

brushed-check-overshirt.heading: Why we took this one
brushed-check-overshirt.lead: Soft from the first wear rather than the fiftieth, which is the only test a flannel has to pass. Six colourways, because this is the piece people come back for in another colour.
brushed-check-overshirt.wear: Buttoned with jeans, open over a white tee, or tied round the waist when the afternoon warms up. Over a long-sleeved top as a jacket in October.

cat-motif-cardigan.heading: Why we took this one
cat-motif-cardigan.lead: The cats are knitted into the body, not appliquéd on, and the contrast placket keeps the whole thing from tipping into novelty. Cream, so it goes with everything you own.
cat-motif-cardigan.wear: Over a white tee and straight jeans. Over a shirt with the collar out if you want the preppy version. Cream goes with everything, which is most of why it sells.

celestial-midnight-a-line-gown.heading: Why we took this one
celestial-midnight-a-line-gown.lead: Long dresses are usually bought for one evening and then hang there. This one is knit on top and corduroy below, so it is warm enough to actually wear in the months you are invited to things.
celestial-midnight-a-line-gown.wear: A heel and nothing else competing — no necklace against the brushstrokes. For a winter evening, a long wool coat over it and a flat gold earring. The brown colourway is the easier one to wear in daylight; the black is the one for after six.

charming-embroidered-fair-isle-knit-vest.heading: Why we took this one
charming-embroidered-fair-isle-knit-vest.lead: The embroidery is stitched, not printed, which is the difference between a Christmas jumper and a piece of knitwear you keep. Look closely and there are little houses in it.
charming-embroidered-fair-isle-knit-vest.wear: Over a long-sleeved white top and jeans is the standard way. Over a collared shirt with the collar out is the better one, and it is what makes it work for an office in December. With a cord skirt and boots for a Sunday.

chic-sophisticated-ribbed-knit-a-line-mi.heading: Why we took this one
chic-sophisticated-ribbed-knit-a-line-mi.lead: A knit dress that does not cling is harder to find than it should be. This one smooths instead, and the belt comes with it, so you are not hunting for one that matches.
chic-sophisticated-ribbed-knit-a-line-mi.wear: Ankle boots and bare legs, or tall boots and opaque tights when it turns. Belted with a long coat for work; unbelted with trainers at the weekend. The gold buttons are enough jewellery on their own.

christian-dean-horse-oil-hand-moisturize.heading: Why it is on the shelf
christian-dean-horse-oil-hand-moisturize.lead: For hands that crack in winter, nothing light is going to do it. Horse oil leaves a layer on the surface rather than soaking straight in, which is the whole reason it works.
christian-dean-horse-oil-hand-moisturize.wear: By the sink, and the last thing before bed — overnight is when a cream this heavy does most of its work. If your hands are badly cracked, put it on and wear cotton gloves to sleep; two nights of that does more than two weeks of a light cream.

command-attention-the-effortless-wide-le.heading: Why we took this one
command-attention-the-effortless-wide-le.lead: Cargo trousers in stiff cotton drill are a young person's game. These are cut from something soft enough to drape, so the volume falls instead of standing away from you.
command-attention-the-effortless-wide-le.wear: Balance the volume with something fitted on top — a cropped top, a close knit, anything tucked. Chunky trainers or boots underneath; a delicate shoe disappears under this much fabric. The khaki is the one that reads as utility, the black as the one that goes to dinner.

cozy-chic-effortless-cool-the-collared-h.heading: Why we took this one
cozy-chic-effortless-cool-the-collared-h.lead: One zip, two sweaters. Up to the chin on a cold platform, down to the collarbone with a chain showing — and the brushed knit is warm without the bulk of a cable.
cozy-chic-effortless-cool-the-collared-h.wear: The cream with light-wash denim is the easy version. The charcoal with black trousers is the one that reads as considered. Over a white shirt with the collar out for an office; under a long coat with the zip to the chin when it turns properly cold.

dermacrew-exosome-all-in-one-ampoule.heading: Why it is on the shelf
dermacrew-exosome-all-in-one-ampoule.lead: The most concentrated thing we sell, and the one customers ask the most questions about. We would rather answer questions than stock something nobody is curious about.
dermacrew-exosome-all-in-one-ampoule.wear: Evening, after toner and before cream. A few drops pressed in rather than rubbed. A firming serum at this strength is worth introducing slowly — two or three nights a week until you know how your skin takes it, then nightly if it is comfortable. Sunscreen the next morning without fail.

drawstring-wide-leg-trousers.heading: Why we took this one
drawstring-wide-leg-trousers.lead: The slits at the hem are the detail: a wide leg usually swallows whatever is on your feet, and these do not. Worn to the airport and to dinner in the same week.
drawstring-wide-leg-trousers.wear: A tucked-in blouse and heels dresses them up; a plain tee does not. The slits want a shoe worth showing — a loafer or a block heel rather than a trainer.

effortless-charm-the-modern-midi-dress-w.heading: Why we took this one
effortless-charm-the-modern-midi-dress-w.lead: The dress is plain on purpose; the heart on the zip pull is the only thing on it asking for attention. That is a better joke than a print, and it survives being worn to work.
effortless-charm-the-modern-midi-dress-w.wear: Boots and a coat for a weekday; heels and small earrings for an evening. The ivory wants bare legs or sheer tights, the black takes opaque. Keep the neckline empty — the heart pull is the jewellery.

effortless-chic-ribbed-lounge-pants.heading: Why we took this one
effortless-chic-ribbed-lounge-pants.lead: There is a version of these in every shop and most of them bag at the knee by the second wearing. The rib on these holds, which is the only thing that separates lounge trousers from pyjamas.
effortless-chic-ribbed-lounge-pants.wear: A plain tee at home. A structured knit and loafers if they are leaving the house, which they will — a wide ribbed leg in black reads as tailoring from six feet away. Avoid anything oversized on top or the whole outfit becomes volume.

effortless-chic-the-everyday-essential-s.heading: Why we took this one
effortless-chic-the-everyday-essential-s.lead: A full trench is a commitment and a lot of fabric. Cut to the hip it keeps every detail that makes a trench a trench and goes over a dress without swallowing it.
effortless-chic-the-everyday-essential-s.wear: Jeans and trainers for the plain version; over a midi dress with boots for the better one. Sleeves pushed to the elbow in April, down with a scarf in October. Under a longer coat in January, which the short cut allows and a full trench does not.

effortless-chic-the-safari-inspired-midi.heading: Why we took this one
effortless-chic-the-safari-inspired-midi.lead: The layered hem is attached, which sounds like a small thing until you have spent a day pulling a shirt down under a cropped jumper. The script across the front is embroidered, not printed.
effortless-chic-the-safari-inspired-midi.wear: Wide-leg trousers, a long skirt, or high-waisted straight jeans. Nothing needs to go under it. The camel and the cream are the easy ones; the ink grey is the one that reads smartest with black.

effortless-flow-denim-collection.heading: Why we took this one
effortless-flow-denim-collection.lead: A pale denim that is not white is the one most people are missing. This wash has grey in it, so it behaves like a neutral instead of like a summer novelty.
effortless-flow-denim-collection.wear: A black tee and trainers is the whole outfit. A cream knit tucked in with loafers is the smarter one. Pale denim shows everything, so this is not the pair for a day with a toddler or a bicycle.

effortless-texture-the-cozy-ribbed-maxi-.heading: Why we took this one
effortless-texture-the-cozy-ribbed-maxi-.lead: This is the piece people build a season around: knit, floor-length, no fastening to think about. We take it in both colours every time it comes up.
effortless-texture-the-cozy-ribbed-maxi-.wear: The cream ivory wants a chunky knit and boots over it. The black takes a tucked-in cami and sandals in summer and disappears under a long coat in winter. Keep the top half fitted — a long skirt and a loose jumper is a lot of fabric.

ekel-hyaluronic-acid-4-in-1-sun-cream.heading: Why it is on the shelf
ekel-hyaluronic-acid-4-in-1-sun-cream.lead: Most people who say they hate sunscreen mean they hate the white cast. This one goes on clear and hydrates enough to replace the moisturiser step for a lot of people.
ekel-hyaluronic-acid-4-in-1-sun-cream.wear: Last step in the morning, two fingers' length for face and neck. It absorbs fast enough to put makeup over without waiting, and it does not pill under a base. Reapply through the day if you are out in it.

eshumi-sun-cream-spf-50-pa-70ml.heading: Why it is on the shelf
eshumi-sun-cream-spf-50-pa-70ml.lead: The big tube at a sensible price, which matters more than any ingredient list — nobody applies enough sunscreen when they are rationing it. This is the one that runs out fastest here.
eshumi-sun-cream-spf-50-pa-70ml.wear: Last step of a morning routine, and again every two or three hours if you are outside. Two fingers' length is the dose for a face and neck; most people use half that and get half the protection.

eshumi-vitamin-hand-cream.heading: Why it is on the shelf
eshumi-vitamin-hand-cream.lead: A hand cream you can use and then immediately pick up your phone. That sounds trivial and it is the reason this tube gets used ten times a day and the rich one does not.
eshumi-vitamin-hand-cream.wear: Whenever you think of it, which is the whole idea. After every hand wash in winter. Keep a heavier cream by the bed for the nights your hands need more than this can give them.

faux-fur-gilet.heading: Why we took this one
faux-fur-gilet.lead: The warmth of a coat across the body with none of the bulk at the arm, which is the whole argument for a fur vest. Four colours, because it is the piece people buy twice.
faux-fur-gilet.wear: The brown and black over jeans, a long-sleeved tee and boots. The white or grey over something you are wearing out in the evening. Keep the sleeves underneath slim — a fur vest over a bulky jumper is a lot of volume in one place.

fine-knit-cardigan.heading: Why we took this one
fine-knit-cardigan.lead: A turtleneck and a cardigan in one garment, because the buttons keep going up through the neck. Four colours, and it is under a coat in January and over a dress in May.
fine-knit-cardigan.wear: Buttoned to the chin under a coat in January. Open over a tee in May. Over a dress as a cardigan the rest of the year. It is the most-worn shape we sell, which is not a complaint.

flared-skater-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
flared-skater-skirt.lead: One of the few things in the shop that works with trainers and with heels, which is why we keep reordering it. A double knit with enough body to swing when you turn.
flared-skater-skirt.wear: A fitted knit and trainers for the daytime; a plain black top and a heel in the evening. Opaque tights from November. The red is the one that needs everything else plain.

flirty-fun-the-cold-shoulder-comfort-swe.heading: Why we took this one
flirty-fun-the-cold-shoulder-comfort-swe.lead: One change to a shape everyone already owns. It is the top for the week in between seasons, when sleeves are too much and bare arms are not enough.
flirty-fun-the-cold-shoulder-comfort-swe.wear: Jeans, a skirt or shorts — it works over all three without needing anything else. The brights are the ones that sell first: the peach and the lime do more for a plain outfit than the white does.

for-the-skin-collagen-gommage-peeling.heading: Why it is on the shelf
for-the-skin-collagen-gommage-peeling.lead: We stopped recommending scrubs years ago and needed something to recommend instead. A gommage rolls off as it dries, so there is nothing abrasive and it is very hard to overdo.
for-the-skin-collagen-gommage-peeling.wear: On dry skin, after cleansing and before anything else. Spread it, wait a minute, then roll it off with light fingers and rinse. Once or twice a week is plenty — it is very hard to overdo, which is most of why we stock it. Follow with a toner and a cream.

harvest-moon-high-rise-pant.heading: Why we took this one
harvest-moon-high-rise-pant.lead: Fleece-lined trousers usually look like what they are. These are cut as a proper high-waisted straight leg, so the warmth is a secret rather than the point.
harvest-moon-high-rise-pant.wear: Cream knits and charcoal both work against the brown. A fine polo neck tucked in and ankle boots is the version that goes out; a sweatshirt and trainers is the version that does not. The short inseam wants a boot rather than a trainer in winter.

hera-sets.heading: Why it is on the shelf
hera-sets.lead: If one habit changes somebody's skin it is double cleansing, and it fails at the first step because water will not touch sunscreen. This is the set we start people on.
hera-sets.wear: On dry skin and dry hands. Massage for a minute, add water to emulsify until it turns milky, then rinse and follow with a foaming cleanser. Evening only — there is nothing to remove in the morning.

heritage-chevron-cardigan.heading: Why we took this one
heritage-chevron-cardigan.lead: The buttons are doing the work of jewellery, which is why the cardigan is finished with nothing else on it. Both colourways sell; the pink goes first.
heritage-chevron-cardigan.wear: Buttoned as a top with wide trousers; open over a white shirt with the collar out. Both colourways sell and the pink goes first. Keep the rest plain — stripes and a second pattern is one thing too many.

heritage-crest-ribbed-cardigan.heading: Why we took this one
heritage-crest-ribbed-cardigan.lead: A column dress lives or dies by whether it holds its line through a long dinner. The elastic waist and the fine rib are what let this one do that without gripping anywhere.
heritage-crest-ribbed-cardigan.wear: Nothing at the neck — the crest is the detail and a necklace will crowd it. A heel and a wool coat for an evening; flat boots and a long cardigan for the version that goes to work. The grey is the easier daytime colour.

heritage-houndstooth-a-line-midi.heading: Why we took this one
heritage-houndstooth-a-line-midi.lead: The check is woven rather than printed, so it has depth to it close up. The flounce at the hem is what stops it reading as a uniform skirt.
heritage-houndstooth-a-line-midi.wear: A cream knit tucked in and tall boots. A black polo neck and loafers for the office version. The green in the check is the one to pick up elsewhere if you pick up anything; most people are better off leaving it alone.

high-rise-metropolitan-straight-leg-jean.heading: Why we took this one
high-rise-metropolitan-straight-leg-jean.lead: A 24 inch inseam on a straight-leg jean is unusual and it is the reason these are here. They are meant to end above the boot, so a shorter leg looks deliberate rather than altered.
high-rise-metropolitan-straight-leg-jean.wear: Leather ankle boots or a sleek heel — the short inseam is designed to show them. A knit tucked in to make the most of the high waist. They will look odd with a trainer unless you are short enough for the hem to sit on the shoe.

holika-holika-soda-pore-cleansing-deep-c.heading: Why it is on the shelf
holika-holika-soda-pore-cleansing-deep-c.lead: Oily skin by lunchtime and blackheads round the nose is the most common thing people ask us about. This has been in production long enough to have earned the shelf space.
holika-holika-soda-pore-cleansing-deep-c.wear: Evening, as the second half of a double cleanse after an oil. Something milder in the morning if your skin runs dry anywhere. Twice a day is too much for most people in winter — if your skin feels tight afterwards, that is the sign.

iconic-70s-flair-wide-leg-denim.heading: Why we took this one
iconic-70s-flair-wide-leg-denim.lead: A flare needs the right shoe under it or the hem drags, which is why most shops do not stock them. Worn properly these change how you stand, and that is worth the trouble.
iconic-70s-flair-wide-leg-denim.wear: A fitted knit or a tucked-in tee keeps the proportion honest. A platform or a block heel under them. Nothing cropped on top — a short top and a long flare leaves nothing in the middle.

iconic-cool-the-varsity-inspired-bomber-.heading: Why we took this one
iconic-cool-the-varsity-inspired-bomber-.lead: Microsuede rather than satin, and piping rather than a logo. It is the varsity shape with everything collegiate taken out of it except the proportions.
iconic-cool-the-varsity-inspired-bomber-.wear: Jeans and a white tee is the obvious outfit and the piping is what lifts it. Over a midi dress it reads as deliberate. The camel is the one that goes with everything; the black is the sharper of the two.

j-vita-anti-uv-vita-collagen.heading: Why it is on the shelf
j-vita-anti-uv-vita-collagen.lead: Waterproof is the one claim on a sunscreen that actually changes your day. This is the tube for a beach or a long walk; keep a lighter one for the office.
j-vita-anti-uv-vita-collagen.wear: Twenty minutes before you go out, and again after swimming or towelling off regardless of what the label survives. This is the tube for a beach or a long walk; keep a lighter one for the office.

jigott-whitening-uv-sun-block-cream.heading: Why it is on the shelf
jigott-whitening-uv-sun-block-cream.lead: Jigott is one of the houses we buy from most often, and this is the tube that comes back into stock fastest after it sells out. Seventy millilitres is enough to use properly.
jigott-whitening-uv-sun-block-cream.wear: Last step of the morning, two fingers' length for face and neck, reapplied through the day if you are out in it. As happy under a base in the city as it is on a beach.

kaleidoscope-color-block-cardigan.heading: Why we took this one
kaleidoscope-color-block-cardigan.lead: Knitted in blocks rather than printed, so the colours meet at real seams. It is the loudest thing on the rail and the one most likely to get a stranger talking to you.
kaleidoscope-color-block-cardigan.wear: Everything else plain. Cream trousers, a white tee, done. Any second pattern and the cardigan stops being the joke and starts being a mess.

kissera-luxury-collagen-uv-sun-cream70ml.heading: Why it is on the shelf
kissera-luxury-collagen-uv-sun-cream70ml.lead: The one to start with if sunscreen has stung before. Aloe is the soothing part, and the texture spreads instead of dragging, which matters on skin that is already unhappy.
kissera-luxury-collagen-uv-sun-cream70ml.wear: Last step in the morning. If sunscreen has stung you before, patch it behind an ear for a night first — a sensitive skin sunscreen is still a product, and nothing suits everybody. Reapply through the day if you are outside.

kissera-pink-tone-up-collagen-sun-cream-.heading: Why it is on the shelf
kissera-pink-tone-up-collagen-sun-cream-.lead: The pink cancels sallowness rather than lightening anything, which is a distinction worth making. It is more wearable on more skin tones than the photographs suggest.
kissera-pink-tone-up-collagen-sun-cream-.wear: On its own for a day with no makeup planned — it does the job a light base would. Under a cushion compact when there is more going on. Reapply through the day; the brightening fades before the protection does, so go by the clock.

ks-collagen-and-retinol-soap.heading: Why it is on the shelf
ks-collagen-and-retinol-soap.lead: A gentle way into retinol, because a bar is on your face for twenty seconds rather than overnight. Start here if a retinol cream has stung before.
ks-collagen-and-retinol-soap.wear: Evening only, starting at three or four nights a week and building up if your skin is comfortable. Follow with a moisturiser every time. Sunscreen the next morning without exception — retinol in any form makes skin more sensitive to UV, and skipping that undoes the work.

ks-niacinamide-melasma-soap.heading: Why it is on the shelf
ks-niacinamide-melasma-soap.lead: The mildest of the three bars from this house: no acid, no retinol, nothing to sting. If you are not sure which one you want, it is this one.
ks-niacinamide-melasma-soap.wear: Morning and evening if your skin is comfortable with it. Follow with a moisturiser, and wear sunscreen daily — tone work of any kind is undone by UV faster than a cleanser can do it.

long-sleeved-maxi-shirtdress.heading: Why we took this one
long-sleeved-maxi-shirtdress.lead: A drawstring at the waist is worth more than any amount of tailoring on a maxi, because you set the shape yourself each morning. Pockets at the hip, which maxi dresses usually skip.
long-sleeved-maxi-shirtdress.wear: Sandals and bare arms in summer with the sleeves rolled. Boots and a long coat in autumn with the waist pulled tight. The brown is the one that reads smartest; the beige is the one people buy for a holiday.

luxurious-flow-the-essential-suede-look-.heading: Why we took this one
luxurious-flow-the-essential-suede-look-.lead: Real suede means a dry cleaner and a careful life. This drapes like it, takes a wash, and comes in the three shades people actually wear it in.
luxurious-flow-the-essential-suede-look-.wear: A chunky knit and boots. Or a fine black polo neck with the black skirt, so the whole thing reads as one colour. Keep the shoe substantial — a long heavy skirt over a delicate sandal looks unbalanced.

m-from-rice-toner-milky-toner-for-glowin.heading: Why it is on the shelf
m-from-rice-toner-milky-toner-for-glowin.lead: Shake it and the two layers come together; leave it and they separate again, which tells you nothing is holding them there artificially. It is the toner people mean when they say glass skin.
m-from-rice-toner-milky-toner-for-glowin.wear: Shake, then press a few drops into clean skin with the palms rather than wiping it on with a pad — a milky toner is absorbed rather than swept away. Morning and night, before serum.

melasma-x-tea-tree-whitening-foaming-cle.heading: Why it is on the shelf
melasma-x-tea-tree-whitening-foaming-cle.lead: Combination skin that breaks out but cannot take anything harsh is the hardest brief in skincare. A mildly acidic foam is the compromise, and this is a good one.
melasma-x-tea-tree-whitening-foaming-cle.wear: Evening, as the second cleanse after an oil. Mornings too if your skin is oily; skip the morning wash if it is not. A combination skin cleanser is only as good as the restraint with which you use it.

mid-century-maven-tweed-coat-dress.heading: Why we took this one
mid-century-maven-tweed-coat-dress.lead: People buy this for a specific day — a wedding in March, a christening, a lunch afterwards. It is warm enough for a cold church and smart enough that you will not need a jacket over it.
mid-century-maven-tweed-coat-dress.wear: Bare legs and a court shoe in summer, opaque tights and a boot in winter. Nothing at the neck. If you need a coat over it, make it plain and long — anything textured will fight the tweed.

midi-length-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
midi-length-skirt.lead: The plainest skirt we stock and the one that outlasts everything bought alongside it. Deep angled pockets, which is rarer in a skirt than it has any right to be.
midi-length-skirt.wear: A striped knit and combat boots is one way; a silk blouse and heels is the other. Belt it with something tucked in, leave the belt off with a jumper over the top. The tan is the one that does the most work; black is the one people buy second.

midnight-cascades-pleated-midi-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
midnight-cascades-pleated-midi-skirt.lead: It is quiet standing still and the hem floats a beat behind you when you walk. Fully lined, which is what stops a semi-sheer hem from being a problem.
midnight-cascades-pleated-midi-skirt.wear: A plain knit tucked in and a heel. Nothing patterned above it and nothing bulky — the skirt is the whole outfit and anything else competing flattens it. A long black coat over the top in winter.

midnight-glen-plaid-tweed-shacket.heading: Why we took this one
midnight-glen-plaid-tweed-shacket.lead: The fringe across the chest is hand-finished and it is the whole reason this came back with us. Without it this would be another check overshirt.
midnight-glen-plaid-tweed-shacket.wear: Over a cream knit and dark denim, buttoned or open. Over a black polo neck and tailored trousers for the version that passes at work. Keep whatever is underneath plain: the fringe and the plaid are enough.

midnight-ribbed-knit-midi-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
midnight-ribbed-knit-midi-skirt.lead: Heavy enough to hold an A-line, soft enough to sit down in without thinking about it. This is the skirt that quietly goes with everything already in your wardrobe.
midnight-ribbed-knit-midi-skirt.wear: Knee boots in January, trainers in March, a slip of a cami in July. It takes a tucked-in knit or an untucked shirt equally well. If you own one knit skirt, this is the shape it should be.

midnight-velour-lounge-sweatshirt.heading: Why we took this one
midnight-velour-lounge-sweatshirt.lead: Velour is the one fabric that feels like nothing else in a drawer full of cotton. Black enough that the sheen reads as texture rather than shine.
midnight-velour-lounge-sweatshirt.wear: Leggings and bare feet at home. Wide-leg black trousers and a loafer if it is going out — velour and tailoring is a better combination than it sounds. Avoid anything else with a sheen on it.

new-anely-suncream.heading: Why it is on the shelf
new-anely-suncream.lead: A water-type formula light enough to wear over skin that breaks out, which rules out most high-SPF creams. Two versions, depending on whether you want the brightening finish.
new-anely-suncream.wear: Last step in the morning, two fingers' worth. It layers under makeup without pilling. Reapply through the day if you are outside for any length of time.

palazzo-trouser-boldly-refined.heading: Why we took this one
palazzo-trouser-boldly-refined.lead: A 23.5 inch inseam is the reason these are here: a tailored check trouser that does not need taking up. The elastic is hidden across the back, so the front stays flat.
palazzo-trouser-boldly-refined.wear: A plain knit tucked in and a loafer or an ankle boot. The grey-scale base takes any colour above it, so this is the trouser to wear with the brightest thing you own. Nothing patterned on top.

paris-chic-meets-cozy-comfort-the-ruffle.heading: Why we took this one
paris-chic-meets-cozy-comfort-the-ruffle.lead: A sporty graphic and a ruffle should not work together, and they do. Cinch the drawstring for a balloon shape or leave it loose for two quite different tops.
paris-chic-meets-cozy-comfort-the-ruffle.wear: High-waisted jeans, shorts or leggings. Cinch the hem for the balloon shape with something slim below; leave it loose over a fuller trouser. The grey marl is the easier of the two to wear.

parisian-chic-tweed-mini-dress.heading: Why we took this one
parisian-chic-tweed-mini-dress.lead: The white collar is doing all the work; it takes twenty years off the tailoring underneath. Short without being brief, which is a harder length to buy than it sounds.
parisian-chic-tweed-mini-dress.wear: Bare legs and a court shoe in September; opaque tights and an ankle boot by November. Nothing at the neck — the collar is the whole point. A plain coat over the top, never a patterned one.

parisian-gilt-textured-cardigan.heading: Why we took this one
parisian-gilt-textured-cardigan.lead: The stripes change direction at the collar and the cuffs, which is a small thing that stops it looking mass-made. Flat enough to pack, warm enough to be the only layer.
parisian-gilt-textured-cardigan.wear: Zipped it reads as a top; open over a white tee it reads as a jacket. Either way it packs flat, which is why it ends up in a suitcase. Keep the rest plain — stripes and a second pattern is one thing too many.

pink-piggy-collagen-cream-for-face-neck-.heading: Why it is on the shelf
pink-piggy-collagen-cream-for-face-neck-.lead: The neck is in the name because almost everybody stops at the jaw. A large pot and a rose scent, which is why it ends up bought as a present as often as for the buyer.
pink-piggy-collagen-cream-for-face-neck-.wear: Morning or night, over a serum. Take it down the neck and onto the chest in the same movement — upwards, not down. If you use a retinol elsewhere, this layers over it comfortably.

pororo-sun-cream-50ml-spf50-pa-k-beauty.heading: Why it is on the shelf
pororo-sun-cream-50ml-spf50-pa-k-beauty.lead: Gentle enough for children, which is the usual reason a household ends up with two tubes of it. The one to buy when you are choosing for somebody whose skin you do not know.
pororo-sun-cream-50ml-spf50-pa-k-beauty.wear: Twenty minutes before going out and again every couple of hours in the sun. On a child, the same quantity you would use on yourself; most people under-apply on children more than on themselves.

prestige-x5-mela-x-cream-10ml.heading: Why it is on the shelf
prestige-x5-mela-x-cream-10ml.lead: A small pot of something strong, which is the honest way to sell a retinol. Two or three nights a week to start, and sunscreen the next morning without exception.
prestige-x5-mela-x-cream-10ml.wear: Two or three nights a week to start, a pea for the whole face, over a toner and under nothing. Build up only if your skin stays comfortable. Sunscreen the next morning without exception — retinol makes skin more sensitive to UV, and a dark spot cream undone by daylight is wasted money.

quilted-liner-jacket.heading: Why we took this one
quilted-liner-jacket.lead: Light enough to go under a coat without bulking the shoulder, and good enough to wear on its own in October. The layer that makes two coats out of one.
quilted-liner-jacket.wear: Over a knit and jeans in October. Under a long coat in January, which is the trick that makes two coats out of one. Over a dress with boots for something less expected.

redius-premium-vitamin-cream-50ml-k-beau.heading: Why it is on the shelf
redius-premium-vitamin-cream-50ml-k-beau.lead: One active doing the work rather than nine ingredients on a box. A sensible place to restart if your routine has grown longer than your morning.
redius-premium-vitamin-cream-50ml-k-beau.wear: Take a small amount, divide it between forehead, cheeks, nose and chin, and spread it out from there. That is how a niacinamide cream is meant to be applied and it uses half as much as scooping does. Morning or night, after serum.

secret-tone-up-sun-cream-spf50-pa-70ml.heading: Why it is on the shelf
secret-tone-up-sun-cream-spf50-pa-70ml.lead: A physical sunscreen sits on the skin rather than soaking in, which suits people who sting with the chemical ones. The tint means it doubles as a base.
secret-tone-up-sun-cream-spf50-pa-70ml.wear: Last step in the morning, two fingers' length, patted rather than rubbed — a physical filter streaks if you drag it. On its own or under a base. Reapply through the day if you are out in it.

sjm-medical-anti-uv-sunscreen-spf-50-pa-.heading: Why it is on the shelf
sjm-medical-anti-uv-sunscreen-spf-50-pa-.lead: The most expensive sunscreen we carry and the one that converts people who had decided they hated sunscreen. A water-film texture finishes smooth instead of tacky.
sjm-medical-anti-uv-sunscreen-spf-50-pa-.wear: Last step in the morning; it sets in under a minute and takes makeup without rolling. Reapply every two or three hours outdoors.

skinpastel-x5-shaking-skin-toner-130ml.heading: Why it is on the shelf
skinpastel-x5-shaking-skin-toner-130ml.lead: Retinol in a toner is lighter than retinol in a cream and sits under the rest of the routine. The shaking is not a gimmick; the two phases genuinely separate.
skinpastel-x5-shaking-skin-toner-130ml.wear: Shake, then press a few drops into clean skin in the evening. Start at two or three nights a week and build up. Follow with a moisturiser. Sunscreen the next morning, without exception.

slogan-crop-sweatshirt.heading: Why we took this one
slogan-crop-sweatshirt.lead: The print is set large across the chest rather than sitting politely in the middle, which is the difference between a slogan top and a souvenir. Cotton, so it washes.
slogan-crop-sweatshirt.wear: High-waisted jeans or a long skirt. Nothing low-rise — the crop needs a waistband to meet. A long coat over it in winter.

sophisticated-ease-the-wide-leg-knit-set.heading: Why we took this one
sophisticated-ease-the-wide-leg-knit-set.lead: A knit co-ord is the whole uniform for a Korean winter, and this is the grown-up version of it. Split up, the jumper goes with jeans and the trousers with a fitted top.
sophisticated-ease-the-wide-leg-knit-set.wear: Together for the tonal version, with a flat boot or a loafer. The jumper with jeans and the trousers with a fitted top for the other two outfits it contains. Nothing patterned anywhere near it.

sophistication-redefined-the-contrast-wa.heading: Why we took this one
sophistication-redefined-the-contrast-wa.lead: The white waistband looks like something layered underneath and it is all one piece. Wear something tucked in or you hide the only interesting thing about them.
sophistication-redefined-the-contrast-wa.wear: A tucked-in blouse or a fitted knit — anything long on top hides the only interesting thing about them. A heel or a loafer; the inseam is cut for a small lift.

tenzero-brightening-yuja-cream.heading: Why it is on the shelf
tenzero-brightening-yuja-cream.lead: Yuja is the Korean citron — the fruit in the tea — and it is the gentle route to brightness without the sting of an acid. There is a matching toner if you want the pair.
tenzero-brightening-yuja-cream.wear: Morning or night, after toner. In the morning it goes under sunscreen; at night it is the last step. Give it six weeks before judging it — brightening is slow by nature.

tenzero-brightening-yuja-toner-200-ml.heading: Why it is on the shelf
tenzero-brightening-yuja-toner-200-ml.lead: Vitamin C without the oxidation problems or the sting. It is the easiest thing to add to a routine that already works, which is the only kind of addition worth making.
tenzero-brightening-yuja-toner-200-ml.wear: Press a few drops into clean skin morning and night, before serum. Pairs with the matching yuja cream if you want the full routine; either works alone.

the-abstract-pleated-statement-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
the-abstract-pleated-statement-skirt.lead: Standing still it is graphic; walking, the pleats keep the pattern moving, and that is the entire reason the skirt exists. Wear nothing else with a pattern on it.
the-abstract-pleated-statement-skirt.wear: Combat boots and a plain black knit in the daytime; heels and nothing else competing in the evening. One colour on top, always — the skirt cannot share a page with another pattern.

the-alabaster-high-rise-sculpt-trousers.heading: Why we took this one
the-alabaster-high-rise-sculpt-trousers.lead: A 27 inch inseam and a small flare, which is a combination most ranges do not bother with. Tailored, and not black, which is rarer than it should be.
the-alabaster-high-rise-sculpt-trousers.wear: A ribbed knit tucked in, or a shirt left out — both read as considered. A pointed flat or a block heel underneath. Keep the top half simple; the flare is the shape doing the work.

the-artisan-chevron-knit-co-ord.heading: Why we took this one
the-artisan-chevron-knit-co-ord.lead: The chevron border is what makes it look designed rather than merely matched. The vest layers over a shirt or a polo neck, so the set does not have to stay a set.
the-artisan-chevron-knit-co-ord.wear: Together with a boot for the tonal version. The vest over a white shirt with jeans; the skirt with a fine knit tucked in. The grey is the easier of the two; the black is the sharper.

the-artisan-pleat-midi-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
the-artisan-pleat-midi-skirt.lead: The stripe panel is set off-centre on purpose — it drags the eye diagonally and makes a pleated skirt look drawn rather than bought. One plain top is all it needs.
the-artisan-pleat-midi-skirt.wear: A cream knit or a plain black top and the skirt does all the work. Boots in winter, a flat sandal in summer. Nothing else striped, patterned or textured anywhere near it.

the-avenue-crest-long-sleeve-dress.heading: Why we took this one
the-avenue-crest-long-sleeve-dress.lead: The contrast trim runs in one unbroken line from collar to hem, which is where the height comes from. It is the dress for a week that needs one thing you can wear for twelve hours.
the-avenue-crest-long-sleeve-dress.wear: A low heel and nothing at the neck. Flat boots and a long coat for a cold day. It is a one-garment outfit, which is the point of owning it.

the-belted-wrap-knit-vest.heading: Why we took this one
the-belted-wrap-knit-vest.lead: A third piece is the hardest thing to buy well, and most of them are either a blazer that needs a shirt under it or a cardigan that reads as a dressing gown. This one ties, so it has whatever shape you give it that morning.
the-belted-wrap-knit-vest.wear: Over a long-sleeved tee and straight jeans in autumn, over a thin knit and trousers in January, over a blouse for an office that does not want a jacket. Belt it for a defined waist with wide-leg trousers; leave it open and long over a slim skirt. In grey it is the quietest of the three; the beige does the most for a tonal outfit, and the navy is the one that reads closest to tailoring.

the-bronze-helm-explorer-slim-fit-jeans.heading: Why we took this one
the-bronze-helm-explorer-slim-fit-jeans.lead: Slim rather than skinny, which is the cut that has survived every swing of the last decade. The whiskering looks like wear rather than like a machine making a point about it.
the-bronze-helm-explorer-slim-fit-jeans.wear: Boots, trainers or loafers all work under a slim leg, which is not true of a wide one. A tucked-in knit for a shape, an untucked shirt for a Saturday.

the-brunello-cucinelli-monili-straight-l.heading: Why we took this one
the-brunello-cucinelli-monili-straight-l.lead: The beading is set into the outside seam and catches the light when you move, which is the entire ornament on an otherwise plain trouser. A slim leg would crowd it; this one does not.
the-brunello-cucinelli-monili-straight-l.wear: A cream knit and a camel jacket makes the tonal version; a black polo neck makes it sharper. A pointed flat or a heel — the stripe runs to the hem and wants to be seen.

the-burgundy-knot-sheath-dress.heading: Why we took this one
the-burgundy-knot-sheath-dress.lead: The knot at the waist is what takes the severity out of a pencil line, and it is the only thing happening on the dress. Desk in the morning, restaurant at night, one change of earrings.
the-burgundy-knot-sheath-dress.wear: A court shoe and a single necklace. A tailored coat rather than a padded one — anything bulky on top undoes the line. Opaque tights in winter, bare legs in summer.

the-chic-minimalist-knit-blazer.heading: Why we took this one
the-chic-minimalist-knit-blazer.lead: The most expensive thing in the shop and the one still in rotation in five years. Seventy per cent wool, handmade, and it holds a shoulder line without a scrap of padding.
the-chic-minimalist-knit-blazer.wear: Over a white shirt and straight trousers for work. Over a tee and jeans at the weekend, which is where a knit blazer beats a tailored one. Cream is the hardest colour to get right in a knit and the easiest to wear once you have.

the-chic-minimalist-trench-dress.heading: Why we took this one
the-chic-minimalist-trench-dress.lead: A coat pattern cut as a dress, which is half of what makes the Korean silhouette recognisable. The khaki-olive takes black, cream, brown and denim without an argument.
the-chic-minimalist-trench-dress.wear: Nude heels and a structured bag for the work version; ankle boots and bare legs for the weekend. Belted with a long coat over it in winter. The lapel wants an empty neckline — no scarf.

the-city-fringe-knit-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
the-city-fringe-knit-skirt.lead: A pencil skirt that behaves like a knit is a rare thing and this is the best one we have had. The fringe swings a half-beat behind you and does all the work.
the-city-fringe-knit-skirt.wear: A tucked-in cream blouse by day and the same skirt with heels after six. Keep the top half simple and close — a pencil skirt with a loose jumper loses the line entirely.

the-coziest-classic-heritage-cable-knit-.heading: Why we took this one
the-coziest-classic-heritage-cable-knit-.lead: Proper cables — raised and ropey, warm because of it rather than for decoration. The warmest thing we sell and the one most likely to be worn until it falls apart.
the-coziest-classic-heritage-cable-knit-.wear: Jeans and trainers with the ivory; black trousers with the black, at which point it stops being casual. Over a tee indoors, under a coat outdoors — it is thick enough that you will not want both unless it is properly cold.

the-deconstructed-chic-trench-skirt-set.heading: Why we took this one
the-deconstructed-chic-trench-skirt-set.lead: The strongest thing we have ever stocked: a trench coat cut off at the waist with a mini skirt under it. Apart, the jacket goes over jeans and the skirt under a knit.
the-deconstructed-chic-trench-skirt-set.wear: Together with a boot and bare legs for the full version. Apart, the jacket goes over jeans and the skirt goes under a knit — which is how most of it will actually be worn. Opaque tights from November.

the-edgy-essential-utility-tie-side-vest.heading: Why we took this one
the-edgy-essential-utility-tie-side-vest.lead: The side ties are functional, and the shape changes completely depending on how you set them. Over a white tee and jeans it turns the plainest outfit you own into something planned.
the-edgy-essential-utility-tie-side-vest.wear: A white tee and straight jeans. A long-sleeved black top underneath in autumn. Over a slip dress if you want the version that surprises people. The ties change the shape completely, so try both before deciding.

the-effortless-chic-wide-leg-denim.heading: Why we took this one
the-effortless-chic-wide-leg-denim.lead: An elasticated back on a jean sounds like a compromise until you have worn them on a long flight. From the outside they are simply a good pair of jeans.
the-effortless-chic-wide-leg-denim.wear: A crisp white tee and trainers in the day; a knit and a heel in the evening. The inseam is cut short, so they sit on the ankle rather than the floor — a boot or a loafer rather than a sandal.

the-essential-knit-jacket-classic-tailor.heading: Why we took this one
the-essential-knit-jacket-classic-tailor.lead: The contrast stitching is what turns a plain knit into something that looks made. It has the authority of a blazer and none of the bulk, which is the whole brief for smart-casual.
the-essential-knit-jacket-classic-tailor.wear: Denim and a tee underneath for the casual version, trousers and a polo neck for the other. Buttoned it reads as a jacket; open it reads as a cardigan with opinions.

the-essential-modern-bomber-elevate-your.heading: Why we took this one
the-essential-modern-bomber-elevate-your.lead: Light enough to carry and enough to cut a morning wind. Over wide denim it is street style; over a dress it is better, because the sportiness against something fluid is what makes the outfit.
the-essential-modern-bomber-elevate-your.wear: Wide-leg denim and trainers for the straightforward version. Over a midi dress for the better one — the sportiness against something fluid is what makes the outfit. Under a heavier coat when it turns.

the-executive-plaid-long-vest.heading: Why we took this one
the-executive-plaid-long-vest.lead: There are no sleeves to shorten, which solves the blazer problem for anyone it usually swamps. The fringed edges and ribbon-trimmed pockets are where the money went.
the-executive-plaid-long-vest.wear: Over a white shirt and tailored trousers for the office. Over a polo neck and jeans at the weekend. It gives a jacket's formality in summer and an extra layer over a knit in winter, which is rare for one garment.

the-executive-pleat-trench-dress.heading: Why we took this one
the-executive-pleat-trench-dress.lead: A double-breasted blazer joined to a knife-pleated skirt, and the join is the whole idea. Buttoned it is a dress; open over a knit and trousers it is a trench.
the-executive-pleat-trench-dress.wear: A court shoe and a plain bag. A polo neck underneath and trousers if you are wearing it open. Nothing patterned — the pleats and the lapels are already two ideas.

the-faux-layered-ribbed-cardigan.heading: Why we took this one
the-faux-layered-ribbed-cardigan.lead: Three tortoiseshell buttons against mint is the contrast the whole piece hangs on. It is the thing people put a hand on before they have read the label.
the-faux-layered-ribbed-cardigan.wear: A white tee and straight jeans. Cream trousers for the tonal version. Nothing else coloured — the mint is doing the work and a second colour flattens it.

the-garden-fresh-knit-vest-a-taste-of-ru.heading: Why we took this one
the-garden-fresh-knit-vest-a-taste-of-ru.lead: Tomatoes on the vine, stitched not printed, with the word embroidered above them. It is silly in the way good knitwear is sometimes silly, and it is the piece people photograph.
the-garden-fresh-knit-vest-a-taste-of-ru.wear: A crisp white shirt underneath with the collar out is the obvious pairing and still the best. A long-sleeved tee for the school run. Over a shirt dress if you want the version that surprises people.

the-heirloom-bloom-knit-vest.heading: Why we took this one
the-heirloom-bloom-knit-vest.lead: The embroidery follows the button placket rather than sitting in a block, which is why it reads as inherited rather than bought. The lilac does more against camel than it sounds like it will.
the-heirloom-bloom-knit-vest.wear: Over a polo neck in winter, over a white shirt the rest of the year. With straight trousers or a midi skirt. Keep whatever is underneath plain — the embroidery is the detail.

the-heritage-corduroy-overshirt-effortle.heading: Why we took this one
the-heritage-corduroy-overshirt-effortle.lead: Longer than a shirt, which is what lets it work as a light jacket. Two colours that are both easier to wear than a navy overshirt, and softer than one too.
the-heritage-corduroy-overshirt-effortle.wear: A knit tied over the shoulders is the way it is photographed and it is a good way. Over denim, trousers or leggings; buttoned over a tee with the sleeves rolled when it warms up.

the-heritage-corduroy-wide-leg-trouser.heading: Why we took this one
the-heritage-corduroy-wide-leg-trouser.lead: Wide-wale cord with real weight to it: the ribs throw a shadow, which is why a plain trouser in this fabric reads as anything but plain. The warmest trousers we sell.
the-heritage-corduroy-wide-leg-trouser.wear: A fine knit tucked in keeps the proportion; anything bulky on top and the whole outfit becomes volume. A boot with some height under them, always.

the-highland-wanderer-plaid-maxi-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
the-highland-wanderer-plaid-maxi-skirt.lead: The most colourful skirt in the shop and still a neutral once a white shirt is above it. Two gathered tiers, which is where the swing comes from.
the-highland-wanderer-plaid-maxi-skirt.wear: A white shirt and boots is the version in the photographs and the right one. A plain black knit for the winter version. Nothing else patterned, and nothing voluminous on top.

the-hooded-flannel-overshirt.heading: Why we took this one
the-hooded-flannel-overshirt.lead: A jersey hood sewn into a flannel collar: not quite a shirt, not quite a jacket, which is the whole appeal. It gets left on the back of a chair and worn again tomorrow.
the-hooded-flannel-overshirt.wear: Over a white tee and jeans it is the easiest outfit in the shop. Over a hoodie in deep winter. The check works over anything plain and nothing patterned.

the-knitted-fringe-midi-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
the-knitted-fringe-midi-skirt.lead: The fringe is what takes it out of the basics drawer, and the three colours are the ones people actually reach for. It quietly becomes the most-worn thing you own.
the-knitted-fringe-midi-skirt.wear: A chunky knit and boots in autumn; a fitted tee and sandals when it is warm. All three colours take black, cream and denim, which is why people buy a second one.

the-midnight-muse-wide-leg-denim.heading: Why we took this one
the-midnight-muse-wide-leg-denim.lead: The darkest denim we stock, with almost no fading in it. Dark jeans take a heel and a blazer as easily as trainers, which is the argument for owning one pair this colour.
the-midnight-muse-wide-leg-denim.wear: A knit tucked in and a heel; a blazer over the top if it is going somewhere with a dress code. Dark denim takes tailoring as easily as trainers, which is the argument for owning one pair this colour.

the-modern-maven-tailored-trousers.heading: Why we took this one
the-modern-maven-tailored-trousers.lead: Cut to end above the shoe, so a shorter leg reads as the design rather than as an alteration you never made. Camel, which does more for a wardrobe than another black trouser.
the-modern-maven-tailored-trousers.wear: A fine knit tucked in and a loafer. White, black, navy or anything jewel-toned above them. A longer coat rather than a cropped one, to keep the line going.

the-rib-knit-luxe-loungewear-set.heading: Why we took this one
the-rib-knit-luxe-loungewear-set.lead: Wide-leg trousers that drape are the difference between a lounge set and a tracksuit. The hoodie on its own goes with jeans, which is how most of it gets worn.
the-rib-knit-luxe-loungewear-set.wear: Together with trainers for a day of errands. The hoodie on its own with straight jeans, which is how most of it gets worn. The mocha is the one that reads least like loungewear.

the-ribbed-full-zip-knit-cardigan.heading: Why we took this one
the-ribbed-full-zip-knit-cardigan.lead: Built like a sweatshirt and knitted like a cardigan, which is the combination most people actually want in October. The rib holds its shape through a day.
the-ribbed-full-zip-knit-cardigan.wear: Jeans, a crossbody bag and trainers — the cardigan is what makes that look assembled. Zipped to the collar under a coat in winter; open over a tee in spring.

the-sailor-collar-midi-dress.heading: Why we took this one
the-sailor-collar-midi-dress.lead: The collar is the point and the rest of the dress is deliberately quiet so it has room. It goes to a christening and then to the pub, which is more than most dresses manage.
the-sailor-collar-midi-dress.wear: Flat boots and bare legs for a weekday; a heel and a long coat for anything else. Nothing at the neck — the collar is already doing it. A plain bag.

the-satin-crest-luxury-blouse.heading: Why we took this one
the-satin-crest-luxury-blouse.lead: Loose satin sits better on most people than a fitted shirt, and it presses flat without a fight. Tucked in it is the dressy half of an outfit; left out it is simply considered.
the-satin-crest-luxury-blouse.wear: Tucked into tailored trousers it is the dressy half of an outfit; left out over jeans it reads as considered rather than casual. Nothing at the neck. A flat gold earring is enough.

the-sunset-luxe-knit-jogger.heading: Why we took this one
the-sunset-luxe-knit-jogger.lead: A cashmere blend soft enough that the first thing anyone does is put a hand on them. Deep pockets that are real, and a tangerine that is far easier to wear than it looks.
the-sunset-luxe-knit-jogger.wear: A fitted knit and a trainer at home; a long coat and a loafer if they are leaving. The tangerine is the loudest thing on the rail and surprisingly easy with cream or grey.

the-tailored-traveler-trousers.heading: Why we took this one
the-tailored-traveler-trousers.lead: Olive behaves like a neutral and is not black, which is most of the appeal. They come out of a suitcase with nothing to answer for and will do a week away on their own.
the-tailored-traveler-trousers.wear: A white shirt and loafers; a black polo neck and boots. The olive takes a bright knit better than any other trouser in the shop.

the-terra-cotta-crochet-midi-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
the-terra-cotta-crochet-midi-skirt.lead: Openwork that is lace without being delicate about it, and fully lined, so the crochet is texture rather than transparency. It is the skirt people pack.
the-terra-cotta-crochet-midi-skirt.wear: A white tee and sandals; a cream knit and boots when it cools. It packs flat and does not crease, which is why it ends up in a suitcase.

the-terra-cotta-crochet-midi-skirt-2.heading: Why we took this one
the-terra-cotta-crochet-midi-skirt-2.lead: The shimmer is worked through the yarn rather than printed on it, so it catches the light as you turn and disappears when you stand still. A mermaid line done in a knit, which moves.
the-terra-cotta-crochet-midi-skirt-2.wear: A fitted knit tucked in and a heel. A plain long-sleeved top and boots for the daytime version. Nothing loose on top — the silhouette is the whole point.

the-terracotta-architectural-pencil-skir.heading: Why we took this one
the-terracotta-architectural-pencil-skir.lead: Terracotta does more for a cream silk shirt than black ever will. The wrap panel draws a diagonal across a shape that is otherwise all vertical lines.
the-terracotta-architectural-pencil-skir.wear: Cream silk, a black knit, or tonal leather. A pointed flat or a low heel. Tuck everything in — a pencil skirt with an untucked top loses the line.

the-urban-explorer-utility-set-modern-ch.heading: Why we took this one
the-urban-explorer-utility-set-modern-ch.lead: The only set we carry with real pockets in both halves. Sporty without being sportswear, and the drawstring hem lets you set the shape of the jacket.
the-urban-explorer-utility-set-modern-ch.wear: Together with a trainer or a flat boot. The jacket over a dress; the skirt under a fine knit. Nothing patterned — this set is about shape and hardware.

the-urban-nomad-corduroy-cargo-pants.heading: Why we took this one
the-urban-nomad-corduroy-cargo-pants.lead: Harvest gold is the colour of the season every season, and it is more wearable than it reads on a screen. Cord instead of drill, so the leg falls rather than stands.
the-urban-nomad-corduroy-cargo-pants.wear: Something fitted on top, always — the leg is doing enough. A black polo neck for the sharp version, a white tee for the easy one. Boots rather than trainers.

ultimate-comfort-unbeatable-style-the-co.heading: Why we took this one
ultimate-comfort-unbeatable-style-the-co.lead: A zip matters more than it sounds in a week of changing weather: open over a tee, closed on the school run. Two of the four greys are different enough to own both.
ultimate-comfort-unbeatable-style-the-co.wear: Together with trainers. The hoodie with jeans; the trousers with a fitted long-sleeved top. Two of the four greys are different enough to own both.

unwind-in-style-the-unavailable-tiered-s.heading: Why we took this one
unwind-in-style-the-unavailable-tiered-s.lead: UNAVAILABLE, PRIVATE REASONS, across the chest — a joke worn at a distance, which is the best kind. The tiers give it a shape so it does not simply hang.
unwind-in-style-the-unavailable-tiered-s.wear: Leggings and trainers for the school run; boots and a long coat if it has to leave the house properly. Nothing fitted over it.

urban-glen-plaid-trench-coat.heading: Why we took this one
urban-glen-plaid-trench-coat.lead: A thread of pink through a black and white glen plaid, which lifts the pattern without turning it into a colour. The only full-length coat we have at the moment.
urban-glen-plaid-trench-coat.wear: Over jeans and a knit it is the piece that makes the outfit; over tailoring it is the one that finishes it. Nothing patterned underneath. A plain scarf or none.

urban-minimalist-high-waisted-wide-leg-p.heading: Why we took this one
urban-minimalist-high-waisted-wide-leg-p.lead: Cropped on purpose, because a wide leg that reaches the floor reads as heavy. Fleece inside, so they are considerably warmer than they look.
urban-minimalist-high-waisted-wide-leg-p.wear: A black knit for the sharp version; a cream one for the tonal. The cropped leg wants a boot or a loafer rather than a trainer, and a sock worth seeing.

varsity-sweat-set.heading: Why we took this one
varsity-sweat-set.lead: Sets are easy to sell and hard to buy well, because the two halves usually only work together. The crop ends at the waist here, so the sweatshirt goes with jeans and the joggers go with anything.
varsity-sweat-set.wear: Together with trainers for the version everyone buys it for. The sweatshirt with straight jeans and a long coat; the joggers with a fitted knit and loafers. The sage green is the one that sells first and the navy is the one that lasts longest.

velvet-whisper-wide-leg-corduroy.heading: Why we took this one
velvet-whisper-wide-leg-corduroy.lead: The warmest trousers in the shop and the reason they sell out before January. Two colours worth the name — emerald and merlot — and both go with cream and camel.
velvet-whisper-wide-leg-corduroy.wear: A fitted knit on top keeps the proportion. A boot, because the hem is cut short. Keep the rest of the outfit neutral — the colour is the event.

verdant-vista-pleated-midi-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
verdant-vista-pleated-midi-skirt.lead: The lace at the hem is the only ornament, and without it this would be another winter midi. The waistband runs from 24 inches to 36, which is why it is sold as one size.
verdant-vista-pleated-midi-skirt.wear: Boots and a denim jacket is the way it is usually worn, and the lace stops that from reading as plain. A fine knit tucked in for something smarter.

vintage-charm-corduroy-pinafore-dress.heading: Why we took this one
vintage-charm-corduroy-pinafore-dress.lead: Nothing on the shoulders, which means the blouse or the knit underneath is half the outfit and you can change it daily. The cord is fine enough for the skirt to gather properly.
vintage-charm-corduroy-pinafore-dress.wear: A high-neck blouse under it in October, a thin knit in January, a long-sleeved tee and boots the rest of the time. Tights and a flat boot for winter.

washed-denim-jeans.heading: Why we took this one
washed-denim-jeans.lead: The fading is done properly — at the hip and the knee, where a pair you had owned for years would fade. Mid-blue and straight, which dates slower than anything else in denim.
washed-denim-jeans.wear: A white shirt and loafers; a knit and boots. Nothing here needs a particular shoe, which is the point of a straight leg.

whimsical-corduroy-a-line-skirt-a-blosso.heading: Why we took this one
whimsical-corduroy-a-line-skirt-a-blosso.lead: The flowers are stitched, so they sit proud of the cord and catch the light. A white tee and trainers is enough; the skirt is the outfit.
whimsical-corduroy-a-line-skirt-a-blosso.wear: A white tee and trainers is enough; the skirt is the outfit. A plain knit in winter. Nothing else with a pattern — the flowers are the whole idea.

whimsical-wonder-vest.heading: Why we took this one
whimsical-wonder-vest.lead: Small embroidered scenes you only notice from a seat away, which is exactly why they work. The cardigan underneath is deliberately plain so nothing competes with them.
whimsical-wonder-vest.wear: Over a plain tee and jeans it does the whole job. Over a shirt with the collar out for something smarter. Four colours, and the green is the one people are surprised by.

whisper-soft-faux-fur-vest.heading: Why we took this one
whisper-soft-faux-fur-vest.lead: A finer pile than the plush one — closer to shearling, and it sits flatter over whatever is underneath. The piece that makes a plain outfit look assembled.
whisper-soft-faux-fur-vest.wear: Over a long-sleeved knit and jeans, or over something sleeveless for an evening. Keep the sleeves underneath slim.

wide-leg-knit-trousers.heading: Why we took this one
wide-leg-knit-trousers.lead: The pair most people buy first and the one we reorder most. They move like loungewear and photograph like trousers, and the four colours cover most wardrobes.
wide-leg-knit-trousers.wear: A fitted knit and boots is the version that goes out; a long tee and bare feet is the version that does not. The cream is the one that looks most expensive and shows the most; the black is the one that gets worn weekly.

wool-blend-long-coat.heading: Why we took this one
wool-blend-long-coat.lead: No collar and no belt, which is harder to cut well than it sounds — there is nothing to hide behind. A long coat is the piece a Korean winter wardrobe is built around.
wool-blend-long-coat.wear: Over everything. Jeans and trainers, a midi skirt and boots, or a dress for an evening. Cream asks for care but does more for a winter wardrobe than navy ever will.

zip-through-hoodie.heading: Why we took this one
zip-through-hoodie.lead: A metal zip and pockets that take hands, which sounds like nothing until you own one without them. It goes with denim, leggings and a mini skirt and makes none of them look accidental.
zip-through-hoodie.wear: Denim, leggings or a mini skirt — it goes with all three and makes none of them look accidental. Under a long coat in winter; over a tee at the gym.
